page.overview:
Who is Fox?

Baby:Height: 0.35 BlocksWidth: 0.3 Blocks

A fox is a neutral mob that spawns in taigas, old growth taigas, snowy taigas and mountain groves. They are able to carry a single item in their mouth, but prefer food over other items.

Foxes spawn in groups of two to four in taiga, old growth taiga, snowy taiga and grove biomes. 5% of them spawn as baby foxes. They can spawn on grass, coarse dirt, podzol, snow blocks, or top snow.

Foxes that spawned in a snowy biome are white.
